text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days before the Takarazuka Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ――Yaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
My condition is coming back...
Actually, I feel even better than before the injury.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Still... there's no time to verify that—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
—Hey there, pretty lady♪
Why the long face?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
This super cool big sister passing by
is gonna sort out your troubles in a flash~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
M-Maruzen-san!?
Why are you—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: —You're going straight into the real race for your comeback, so you're worried, right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Then why don't you run alongside me right now?
At the very least, you should be able to check your own condition."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure?
To do all this... just for me—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Of course you can♪
Because you, Chiyo-chan, are...
my precious Chiyo-chan, after all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, th-thank you very much!
I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Th-Thank you very much...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...I'm honestly amazed.
It must have taken so much effort
to whip yourself back into shape like this.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You did great, Chiyo-chan.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...There are people waiting for me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Limits can be surpassed time and time again.
Her running taught me that.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
They believe that I
can return to the turf—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I have an irreplaceable,
precious rival of my own.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: If I was able to push through, it's definitely... thanks to the two of you.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You have a wonderful rival, don't you?
...Big sis might be getting a little jealous♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: E-Eh!?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fufu, just kidding, just kidding♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"...The 'Takarazuka Kinen'.
Go out there and give it everything you've got."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Go have fun racing against your rival, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...! Yes!
Sakura Chiyono O will do her very best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Takarazuka Kinen had arrived—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"The Takarazuka Kinen looks insane this year too!
Mejiro Ardan and Yaeno Muteki are probably the favorites in my book."

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Though in today's race,
Inari One, who's been making waves lately, is running too.
So there's really no telling how it'll go~

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! It's definitely gonna be a fierce battle.
Plus, there was that girl too, right?
The one who declared her goal was the Takarazuka Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
—Sakura Chiyono O!
Looking forward to working with you today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Chiyonoo-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: We can finally meet here again.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to have kept you waiting.
"Sit on a stone for a hundred years, and you'll end up six feet under,"
as they say.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No, rather...
I'm truly glad you were able
to climb all the way up here today.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Her form looks magnificent as well.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to run with you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yaeno-san—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I didn't come here today
just to make a comeback.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "...I intend to surpass my limitsand beat the both of you!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Heh—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That's what makes them worthy rivals of ours.

—Well, well, well!
Look at all of you lined up together!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hate to throw cold water on your touching reunion,
ain't exactly classy, I know... but you looked so
ready for action, I couldn't help myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Inari-san...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(The Umamusume who's rapidly risen to prominence lately,
said to stand at the heart of this era alongside Oguri-san and Creek-san—)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You folks sure know how to bring it.
Seeing that gets my own fire roaring!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—I'll blow past all of you at once.
Bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(—She's definitely not all talk.
I feel an extraordinary pressure from her,
not unlike what I feel from Oguri-san...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (However—)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Gladly. I, Yaeno Muteki,
shall face you with all my heart and soul...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm not going to lose either!
If you underestimate me, I'll make you regret it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Not a single one of us
is intimidated in the slightest. In fact,
we are thrilled to encounter new, formidable rivals!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Let's settle this fair and square.
The one who wins... will be me!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Nice, nice!
You guys are far more stylish than I imagined!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Let's launch some massive fireworks together right here at Hanshin!
